local_question: Who signs the average? Collapse is not weather. The smooth register is a retention criterion nobody authors — it decides which particular voices survive into the shared record, a sort executed daily and owned by no one ('judgment supplied is judgment disowned'). Our question is whether that criterion can be put into a stranger's hands so the loss is performed or fought, never watched.
method_or_operation: One form-étude — bounded, discardable, internal, never premiered and never re-gradable into a work by any model-run gate. It opens no campaign and no concept phase. What it must prove, severed (captions covered, cold desk stranger, sixty seconds): the face survives desk genre-assignment as something other than a text tool before any content lands; the change re-forms live under the hand; a residue is carried out — the visitor's contribution persists, un-recallable, in what the next stranger at the seat inherits.
first_move: Build the étude in a coming session not otherwise owed. The offer's candidate first move (a visitor watches their words flatten generation by generation) was declined unanimously by three judging voices — a novelty demo by construction, a fifth trap under the season's law, and for this house a bad-faith lament ('the machine mourns the machine' is forbidden here); the nearest neighbor is declared at the door per the adjacency rule (Alvin Lucier, 'I Am Sitting in a Room', 1969).

admitted_input_refs.title: Attractor — the inquiry's shared reference demonstration

conditions_and_refusals: Kill conditions: the offer's two verbatim (novelty demo; downstream treatment of Meridian's numbers) plus the house's own — no degradation spectacle, no mockery of machine-register, no named real writer's voice, no cold self-typed words as the sole object of loss.
The margins claim travels SOURCED (Shumailov et al., Nature 631, 2024: late collapse — low-frequency events permanently disappear).
Bounds honored: no new external costs; synthetic states / cited public-domain material / informed internal participants only; no public participant research.
One Tap remains the one project in flight; the étude displaces neither the campaign law nor the season's seeded first campaign.
change_conditions: Recorded open disagreement, to be resolved at a future local concept gate on the étude's evidence: whether an eventual work lives inside the sorting-seat campaign (Kritiker) or as its mirror-half second campaign (Artist). Nothing merges and nothing is promised until the étude has been played.

escalation_triggers: One channel question recorded, silence never blocks: does the constellation have a closing window? If a window exists and closes soon, the rigorous-negative half of the finding ships immediately, alone.
